blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **зна́тный** — noble. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: I feel in my bones that the party will be a great success.
exercises.why: **знатная** — зна́тный: noble; outstanding, distinguished; (colloquial) good, excellent. Wiktionary: знать + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ста́тный** — stately. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ли́чный** — personal (relating to a particular person). Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зна́тный — noble; ста́тный — stately; ли́чный — personal (relating to a particular person); де́льный — efficient, businesslike.
**личный** — ли́чный: personal (relating to a particular person); (grammar) personal. Wiktionary: лицо́ + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **де́льный** — efficient, businesslike. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: He gave me a good piece of advice.
exercises.why: **дельный** — де́льный: efficient, businesslike; sensible. Wiktionary: де́ло + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ми́рный** — (relational) peace. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**мирный** — ми́рный: (relational) peace; peaceful; friendly; (military, relational) civilian, non-combatant. Wiktionary: мир + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ми́рный — (relational) peace; си́льный — strong, powerful; ви́дный — visible, conspicuous; слы́шный — audible (able to be heard).
